name: Shared LC-MS bench
status_line: Not in PyLabRobot. The toolkit playbook's route, a Ready line and a Start line, needs no decoding.
reaches: Rear remote connector: software reads a Ready line and closes a Start contact through opto-isolators (plr-reverse-engineer/instruments/agilent-6530-qtof/README.md:88-97). The vendor software holds the method. Raw files are picked up from a data folder.
decoded_from: Nothing to decode for this route. Upstream has no LC, MS or autosampler driver (no match in pylabrobot/ or docs/_static/devices.json). The signals come from the toolkit playbook; its LAN control map is still in progress (plr-reverse-engineer/instruments/agilent-6530-qtof/README.md:164-165).
steps: Find the model, photograph the rear panel and read the remote connector pinout from its manual; do not assume pin numbers (plr-reverse-engineer/instruments/agilent-6530-qtof/README.md:93-95).
Wire Ready, Start, Stop and ground through opto-isolators or relays; never wire GPIO straight to the instrument (plr-reverse-engineer/instruments/agilent-6530-qtof/WIRING.md:33-35).
Find the Ready line and its sense with the toolkit's line scan command (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/cli.py:63-77), then confirm Ready read-only before any Start.
Load the injection sequence and method in the vendor acquisition software.
With a person present, close Start for 1 injection and check that 1 raw file appears in the data folder.
Point the adapter at the data folder and match each injection to its raw file before the next Start.
scenario: 8 aliquots from 1 plate as an injection sequence: for each, check Ready, log the dry-run Start (nothing sent), wait for its raw file. A missing file holds; Ready low stops with the fault text.
real: plr_re contact-closure controller and guards, in dry run (the example in the playbook)
The Start note the toolkit logs in dry run
simulated: The acquisition workstation, its Ready line and sequence
Raw files: 1 text stub per injection in a temporary folder
not_checked: Whether the hall's LC-MS has a remote Ready and Start connector
Any pin, polarity or pulse length on hardware
How long an injection takes and how the real raw files are named
limits: The toolkit's Start and Ready path has mock and dry-run tests only (plr-reverse-engineer/tests/test_plr_re.py:108-131 and plr-reverse-engineer/README.md:119-120); hardware validation is still to come (plr-reverse-engineer/instruments/agilent-6530-qtof/README.md:166).
In dry run start_run transmits nothing (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/instruments/agilent6530.py:97-103); the example relays the logged note to the simulator.

Start is 1 TTL line and carries no sample id (plr-reverse-engineer/instruments/agilent-6530-qtof/WIRING.md:10-20). The vendor sequence sets the order, so the adapter matches by row, with a file name rule made up here.
wait_ready sleeps for real (plr-reverse-engineer/plr_re/instruments/agilent6530.py:86-93), so the example reads is_ready once per injection instead.
